name: @avatark/world-adaptation-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 15's bounded world-adaptation derivation: signal extraction from already-authoritative Sprint 7-14 facts, deterministic decaying pressure accumulation, threshold-gated decision, and typed, closed effect derivation. Pure, Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral -- never applies an effect itself, that boundary is the Host layer's (lib/worldAdaptation/hostService.ts), the same posture every sibling runtime package already holds.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
